Delete a Departure Reason

User manual · English · 8 steps
Learn how to delete a departure reason that was added by mistake. Reasons cannot be archived, only deleted.

1. Open Employees

Open the Employees app.

2. Configuration menu

Open the Configuration menu.

3. Departure Reasons

Click Departure Reasons.

4. Find the departure reason

Type the name of the departure reason and press Enter.

5. Select it

Tick the box in front of the departure reason.

6. Actions

Click Actions.

7. Delete

Click Delete.

8. Confirm

Click Delete in the window to confirm.
